## Install

1. Download [`sakura-dusk.json`](sakura-dusk.json) (open it, then click **Download raw file**).
2. In **YouTube Theme Studio**, go to **Export → Import backup** and pick the file.
3. The theme applies right away and is saved under your profiles.
